title: Nice non-stick whisk for every kitchen!
text: Nice non-stick whisk for every kitchen!. I really, really like this whisk. Super light in my hands, it makes mixing a breeze. The fact that it is silicone means that it' s non-stick properties allow food and batter to wash off easily. This has a real stainless steel look and blends with all the other utensils in my kitchen. This is a great device and every home and chef should have one. Highly recommend!

product_metadata.title: MJIYA Silicone Whisk, Stainless Steel & Silicone Non-Stick Coating Hand Egg Mixer, Balloon Egg Beater for Blending, Whisking, Beating, Frothing & Stirring (10 inch, Black)
features: 【Heat resistant】: Silicone is heat resistant up to 450 degrees Fahrenheit, perfect for cooking almost any meal
【No more scratches on your expensive pans】: This whisk is made of durable stainless steel with wires coated in soft silicone – perfect for whisking sauces, gravy or eggs right in the pan!
【Stainless-steel construction】: made of 18/0 stainless steel (80%), the durable wires and handle ensure long-lasting reliable strength.

【Professional Design】: The handle adopts professional sealing design, making it's will not fills with water. Ergonomic narrow shape design make whisks for cooking more comfortable to be used. The end of the handle designed with a hook allow for easy hanging, allowing for easy storage.

【Easy to use】: No more having to worry about transferring ingredients to a different bowl to whisk your ingredients. These silicone whisks make blending, Aerating and whisking easy to do in the kitchen. The balloon design will make easy work of making a quick homemade whipped cream or scrambling eggs before cooking..Easy to clean: Simply wash with Warm water and soap- it's that easy!
